headline: Bloom Energy Beats Q3 Earnings by 36% on AI Data Center Power Demand
summary: Fuel-cell manufacturer Bloom Energy beat third-quarter earnings expectations by 36% and revenue estimates by 15%, driven by surging electrical power demand from artificial intelligence data centers.
why: Bloom Energy produces solid oxide fuel cells for on-site power generation. Expanding hyperscale data centers are turning to private distributed generation to bypass grid interconnect delays.

impacts.name: Bloom Energy Corp
impacts.why: Significant quarterly earnings and revenue beats validate surging commercial power demand from data centers.

why_moved: A 36% earnings beat and 15% revenue upside driven by AI data-center demand stimulated trading volume in Bloom Energy stock.
